environment.description: Go Gin application running on EC2 instance in VPC subnet-0e5f6a7b with IAM role granting s3:PutObject and s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::app-user-uploads-prod/*. All S3 traffic routes exclusively through VPC endpoint vpce-0x9y8z7w6v (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, Gateway type) with route table rtb-0m1n2o3p forcing all S3-prefix traffic through the endpoint. The VPC endpoint has an attached endpoint policy document that includes a Condition block with StringLike on s3:prefix requiring 'uploads/general/*' for s3:ListBucket and a separate Condition with StringLike on s3:objectkey matching 'uploads/general/*.jpg' OR 'uploads/general/*.png' OR 'uploads/general/*.gif' for s3:PutObject actions. Additionally the endpoint policy restricts the aws:RequestedRegion to us-east-1 and requires s3:x-amz-content-type to match 'image/*'. The bucket itself has a bucket policy with a Deny statement for any s3:PutObject where aws:sourceVpce is NOT vpce-0x9y8z7w6v, effectively ensuring no upload can bypass the endpoint restrictions.

config.subnet: subnet-0e5f6a7b (private, no NAT route for S3 prefix)
config.route_table: rtb-0m1n2o3p with pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) -> vpce-0x9y8z7w6v
